title: Graph Forecasts for Time Series
text: graph_explore() starts app background opens browser. Stop plumber2::api_stop() starting another.
code: library(grafts) library(fable)  # Trips are recorded in thousands tourism_agg <- aggregate_key(   tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips) * 1e3 )  # The structure is inferred from the keys: Purpose * (State / Region) app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg) plumber2::api_stop(app)  # With forecasts, drawn after the data with their intervals tourism_fit <- model(tourism_agg, ets = ETS(Trips), snaive = SNAIVE(Trips)) tourism_fc <- forecast(tourism_fit, h = "2 years") app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg, forecasts = tourism_fc)

code: if (interactive()) {   library(fable)   tourism_agg <- aggregate_key(     tsibble::tourism, Purpose * (State / Region), Trips = sum(Trips)   )    # The structure is inferred from the keys: Purpose * (State / Region)   app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg)   plumber2::api_stop(app)    # With forecasts, drawn after the data with their intervals   tourism_fit <- model(tourism_agg, ets = ETS(Trips), snaive = SNAIVE(Trips))   tourism_fc <- forecast(tourism_fit, h = "2 years")   app <- graph_explore(tourism_agg, forecasts = tourism_fc)   plumber2::api_stop(app) }
